question.text: To manage MARKET risk (which cannot be diversified away), a PM uses:

answer.text: Buying more of the best performer

explanation.text: The Logic: Systematic/market risk needs hedging instruments — index puts, futures shorts, swaps. Diversification addresses unsystematic risk. The Trap: Diversification is limited to unsystematic; turnover doesn't change aggregate market exposure. Cross-Exam Context: VIII cover hedging; XXI-B ties to risk framework. Manager's Pro-Tip: SEBI restricts PMS derivative use — document hedge rationale clearly and maintain client consent in the DD.
